_header: ADR-0225 `directory` residue ratchet — the recorded state of the sweep.
These are NOT floors. They are DESCENDING RATCHETS, and both directions
are a failure:
rising  — residue grew. That is the regression the sweep exists to
catch. Re-key the new sites onto `project_id`, or (ADR-0460)
raise the number WITH a stated reason when the growth is
load-bearing. Never raise it to absorb a car's own drift.
falling — either the matcher broke or the cleanup finished. If it
finished, commit the new number IN THE SAME CHANGE as the
deletion, so the sweep's progress and its record never drift
apart. If the matcher broke, fix the matcher.
equal   — pass.
Re-record with:
python scripts/check_directory_residue.py --update-ratchet
That path refuses to write when a COVERAGE floor (MIN_FILES_SCANNED,
MIN_TOOLS_CHECKED) is breached — a number recorded from a walk that never
reached the tree is the same blindness this file exists to prevent.
`residue_hits`     — total `directory`-family tokens in a scoping position.
`sibling_entries`  — allowlist entries parsed out of the sibling lints
(C9a _ALLOWLIST + C9a _SWEPT + C9b ALLOWLIST).
